_comment: Hosts taken off the site. Their old pages, in every language, become static redirect stubs (astro.config.mjs, removedHostRedirects) to the same-language activity hub, noindex and out of the sitemap. 'workshops' are the per-class subpage keys they had (slugify of the class title, shared by every language). If a host comes back and her page is built again, the stub for that path is skipped, so removing her entry here is tidy but not required.
